metadata.title: WRF namelist.input merged registry and metadata catalog
notes: Structure, types, comments, and registry defaults come from the registry JSON when available.
Descriptions and published defaults are layered from the users guide JSON when available.
Enum values are layered from select values, then inventory.
Additional defaults and descriptions are layered from manual and readme JSON when available.
Normalized defaults strip trailing commas and convert logical/numeric strings to native JSON types.
